entries.text: Seasonal access after the rains will decide whether any of this can be reached.
Border raids have slowed since mid-September.
The pressure is displacement, not attacks; registration could stay flat while the border stays quiet.
Market prices in Abeche would tell you about absorption capacity, and nobody is tracking them.
Nothing I have seen this week would move me either way.

why: checking the Adre claim before the draft
means: These lines were written by one person each. They are the most worth checking and the most likely to identify their author in a panel of eight, which is why they are here and not in the published result.
corroboration_note: Absence from the checked databases is not evidence of falsity.
